stages.name: Tide Pool
stages.blurb: The King needs a small sticky star. Roll the shallows.
stages.kingPraise: Hmm! Sticky, round, and faintly fishy. Perfect. Hang it in the sky!

stages.name: Coral Reef
stages.blurb: Bigger waters. Bigger ambitions. Make a proper reef-star.
stages.kingPraise: Magnificent lump! The cosmos looks slightly more... moist. I approve.

stages.name: Harbor
stages.blurb: Roll the docks. Leave no buoy un-scooped.
stages.kingPraise: A lighthouse of junk! Truly, my child, you understand stickiness.
